cases.name: etaf-ui-markdown-render-requires-a-palette
cases.purpose: Rendering a colored block without its palette or with an unknown key signals the markdown error.

cases.name: etaf-ui-markdown-renders-blocks-and-inline-styles
cases.purpose: Headings, inline emphasis and code, lists, fenced code, tables, quotes and callouts publish their content while HTML comments stay invisible.

cases.name: etaf-ui-markdown-callbacks-replace-media-and-code
cases.purpose: The render-code-block and render-media callbacks own the rendered block and replace the default.

cases.name: etaf-ui-markdown-media-falls-back-to-text
cases.purpose: Without a media callback an image keeps its alt text instead of disappearing.

cases.name: etaf-ui-markdown-alert-labels-override-defaults
cases.purpose: The alert-labels environment overrides the label of its kind only.

cases.name: etaf-ui-markdown-line-grid-keeps-body-size
cases.purpose: The line-grid environment keeps headings and footnote references at the body font size.

cases.name: etaf-ui-markdown-table-columns-follow-content
cases.purpose: Table columns share the width by content and cells wrap at word boundaries.

cases.name: etaf-ui-markdown-table-keeps-unbroken-columns
cases.purpose: A table column is never narrower than its widest unbreakable cell text, so words and short CJK runs stay whole.

cases.name: etaf-ui-markdown-code-link-links-a-code-span
cases.purpose: The code-link callback turns a code span into an activatable link while the span keeps its code style.

cases.name: etaf-ui-markdown-code-link-inside-a-link-keeps-one-decoration
cases.purpose: A linked code span that is also a code link renders with one text decoration instead of a duplicate View property.

cases.name: etaf-ui-markdown-code-bg-colors-code-spans
cases.purpose: An optional code-bg palette entry colors inline code and falls back to panel without it.

cases.name: etaf-ui-markdown-links-hover-with-the-accent-tint
cases.purpose: A rendered link carries the accent-soft hover face while code spans keep their code background.

cases.name: etaf-ui-markdown-table-keeps-short-cjk-cells-whole
cases.purpose: A starved table column still fits a short CJK word on one line instead of splitting it between characters.
